# SmallDocs

SmallDocs is a Markdown reader and editor, a command line tool for opening local files and creating share links, a hosted workspace for documents you choose to store in SmallDocs Cloud, and an SDK for rendering SmallDocs documents in web applications.

## Use SmallDocs locally

- [Install the CLI](https://smalldocs.org/install)
- [Product documentation](https://smalldocs.org/docs)
- [Standard SmallDocs agent skill](https://smalldocs.org/agent-skills/standard/.well-known/agent-skills/smalldocs/SKILL.md)
- [Standard skill catalog](https://smalldocs.org/agent-skills/standard/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)

## Use SmallDocs Cloud

- [Cloud overview, setup, and pricing](https://smalldocs.org/cloud)
- [Cloud-aware SmallDocs agent skill](https://smalldocs.org/agent-skills/cloud/.well-known/agent-skills/smalldocs/SKILL.md)
- [Cloud skill catalog](https://smalldocs.org/agent-skills/cloud/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
